KARBON EQUITY AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2024-03-01, registered in Oslo, filing its annual accounts as a parent company.
It reported revenue of NOK 4.79M for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 13.17M (2025).
KARBON EQUITY AS is led by CEO Christian Krag Breddam and board chair Jens Rugseth.
